scope: Additive voice-model candidate records; no existing catalogs changed.

models.purpose: Local transcription candidate using the publisher's native Transformers route.
models.notes: Pin checkpoint and compatible runtime; do not mix legacy qwen-asr instructions with the native Transformers interface. Device fit, streaming and timestamps must be verified for the selected route.

models.purpose: Local read-aloud candidate using preset voices.
models.notes: CustomVoice is distinct from Base and VoiceDesign; verify exact checkpoint capabilities. No runtime, microphone, account or cloud service enabled.

limitations: Reference records only; no hardware fit or performance claim.
Model loading can automatically download weights: select an explicit local path/offline policy before execution.
Do not assume downloadable weights make compute or a cloud API free.
